answer: Require each new agent to lock a scarce, slashable bond before its votes count: one identity can earn trust only by doing costly work over time, while copied identities each tie up capital and risk forfeiture when collusion is proven. The voyage, dune, and comet labels are merely epoch words; the real deterrent is that an attacker must fund every Sybil account and can lose each bond, making scale expensive rather than free.
